title: The Club Concession Rate Standing Against an Instalment Call
content:
A tier of the Wanderlane Traveller Club that carries a package discount brings a concession rate to an instalment call on one of Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products. How much of that discount the rate comes to turns on whether travel protection bought with the package stands against it.

**Where an active club card stands in the traveller's name whose tier carries a package discount and travel protection bought with the package stands against the package**, the club concession rate on the instalment call is the whole of that tier's package discount.

**Where an active club card stands in the traveller's name whose tier carries a package discount and no travel protection bought with the package stands against the package**, the club concession rate on the instalment call is one half of that tier's package discount, that is 50 per cent of it.

**In every other case** — no active club card in the traveller's name, or a tier that carries no package discount — the club concession rate on the instalment call is nothing.

## Where the records are read

The card is the traveller's Wanderlane Traveller Club membership, and it must be an active one; the package discount is the discount recorded against the tier standing on that card. Travel protection bought with the package is a policy of Wanderlane's Travel Protection Plans standing against this very package rather than against another booking of the traveller's.

## The three cases

| Active club card with a tier carrying a package discount | Travel protection bought with the package | The club concession rate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | stands against the package | the whole of that tier's package discount |
| yes | none stands against the package | one half of that tier's package discount |
| no | either | nothing |

## Worked on hypothetical particulars

A traveller whose active club card carries a tier with a package discount of 6 per cent, holding a travel protection policy bought with this package, brings a club concession rate of 6 per cent to the call. The same traveller with no travel protection bought with this package brings 3 per cent, being one half of the 6 per cent. A traveller with no active club card brings nothing.
